Home Office,

Bournemouth,
Hants.

L 4050/4.
Your ref. P.F. 49542/E.5.
(3).
23rd October, 1941.

Mr. W.C. Edwards.
M.1.5(B.8).

Instructions have to-day been given for the release of Ernst LOEWEINHEIM now interned. Category 19.

He is to be exempted from the Special Restrictions imposed by Articles 6A and 9A of the Aliens Order, 1920, as amended.

The alien is to proceed direct to and to no other place.

ON THE BLACK LIST.

ENCL
24 OCT 1941
TO ES
REF PF 49542
